content:
nisha-pm: FYI partner CloudMarket started reporting cpu usage with unit="ms_cpu" in the 00:00-04:00 UTC window. We observed inflated consumption in ledger snapshots.
cheng-eng: sample shows values like {"usage_id":"u-112","unit":"ms_cpu","value":360000}. Our price calc expected cpu_seconds.
oscar-billing: if we treat ms_cpu as seconds we'll overbill ~1000x. Any invoices issued yet?
partner-bot: alert: meter.unit_unknown events detected for vendor=cloudmarket between 2100506740-2100506820, count=6k.
cheng-eng: proposed quick fix: map ms_cpu -> cpu_seconds with factor 0.001 at ingest transformer, tag events with X-Partner-Unit=MAPPED and put originals to DLQ for audit.
nisha-pm: agree. also add a reconciliation run for last 72h, dry-run first. If billed_delta > $25 create adjustment ticket.
oscar-billing: include columns: customer_id, usage_id, original_unit, original_value, mapped_value, billed_delta_usd, invoice_state. Finance needs CSV.
cheng-eng: I'll open branch feat/map-mscpu and add unit conversion tests + DLQ wiring. Will add metric meter.unit_mapped_count and meter.unit_mapping_failures.
deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for feat/map-mscpu at 2100506850
partner-bot: recommend notifying CloudMarket PM immediately with sample payloads and request producer patch. nisha-pm: I'll draft the partner note and coordinate.
cheng-eng: fallback: if partner sends batched records without usage_id, we'll synthesize stable id via sha256(partner_id+timestamp+seq) so replay is deterministic.
oscar-billing: for replay: run dry-run, produce CSV, then if adjustments needed we will auto-create billing tickets and notify account owners.
nisha-pm: owners: @cheng-eng for hotfix, @oscar-billing for recon + tickets, @nisha-pm for partner comms. Target: hotfix + dry-run by EOD today.
